_instructions: The retention gate is ≥ 60% voluntary use, at least once a week, for four CONSECUTIVE weeks. The four weeks cannot be compressed and the cohort has to be fixed before they start — a cohort assembled afterwards from whoever kept using it scores 100% every time.

`users` holds the platform-core user id (uuid) of every onboarded pilot participant, including the ones who never come back. Dropping a non-returner is the single easiest way to manufacture a passing retention number.
Rename to pilot_cohort.json once the cohort is fixed. The harness reads weekly activity from `queries.asked_by` — voluntary use means a question asked, not a session opened.
business_unit: REPLACE — one business unit, per the plan
